reason: Adds browser-based Grok account login to DeepSeek Harness so users can access Grok models through a SuperGrok or X Premium+ subscription without configuring an xAI API key.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加基于浏览器的 Grok 账户登录，让用户使用 SuperGrok 或 X Premium+ 订阅访问 Grok 模型。
summaries.en: Adds browser-based Grok account sign-in to DeepSeek Harness for accessing Grok models with a SuperGrok or X Premium+ subscription.

capabilities: Network access to xAI authentication and chat proxy endpoints
Grok model catalog and chat access through an existing subscription
Optional reuse of an existing official Grok CLI session
